text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Hosted API (us-east-1) queue spike. p99 latency > 15s, queued requests ~28k, GPU pools exhausted. Autoscaler failing to provision VMs (quota/429 errors). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-queue
alex (sre-oncall): Acknowledged. I'm taking pager. Tagging eng-infra @ben-salas and eng-runtime @charlie-runtime. Any immediate mitigation steps?
ben-salas: Confirming provisioner logs show repeated cloud API 403/429: `provisioner.create error: QuotaExceeded` then `rate_limited`. Backoff increasing, attempted 6 creations, 0 success.
dana-ops: Support triage: multiple customers reporting 504s and hanging streams. CS has temp banner ready. p95 ~4s -> p99 ~18s on affected endpoints (/v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream).
charlie-runtime: Autoscaler leader is flapping; leader election timeouts. Secondary not promoting cleanly. Could be coordinator DB slowness under load. Immediate option: disable autoscale and manually scale up a preemptible pool, plus route low-priority tenants to fallback model.
alice-nguyen: I'm enabling fallback routing and throttling low-priority tenants now. Command: `redwood route update --fallback=redwood-small-quant --throttle=low-priority:50` Posting output in a sec.
sre-oncall alex (sre-oncall): Good. Post outputs here. I'll create incident channel and kick off customer comms. @incident-bot can you create channel and notify execs?
incident-bot: Channel created: #incident/1767001122-evening-fanout. Alerts sent to on-call rotation, eng-infra, eng-runtime, product. Incident severity set to P1.
ben-salas: Manual pool spin: requested 4 x a100-preemptible via cloud API. Response: 2 created, 2 pending. Cloud returned one partial failure with quota note. Raised cloud support ticket CLOUD-7891 with priority A. ETA for remaining nodes ~6m.
olivia-cs: CS template posted to #incident/1767001122-evening-fanout. Outreach to top 5 affected customers initiated. Will provide updates every 15m and escalate any escalations immediately.
charlie-runtime: Also flipping per-route circuit breaker to reduce new inflight: POST https://console.internal/internal/circuit with payload `route=/v1/generate&limit=50` — applying now. Should slow the fanout and let KV prefix cache settle.
alex (sre-oncall): Handing to night SRE @eric-sre for watch after we hit steady state. Eric — confirm fallback is serving and p99 < 5s before marking mitigation. If provisioner still failing after 10m, escalate to infra oncall and consider customer-level throttles.
eric-sre: On it. Monitoring queue and provisioner logs. Will report back in 5m. :thumbsup:
